three tools = lit grid with official logos, each panel lights on its name; no caption keyword while it is up
a list of three ways as stacked lower thirds, each wiped in on its phrase; 11 s after the grid
two reassurance lines: slow push, keyword on 'sounds like you' then on 'only when you're happy' (it never sends on its own)
